column2: sadanāt ṛtasya vi raśmibhiḥ sasṛje sūryaḥ gāḥ vi
na payasā pīpyānāḥ uta sye naḥ marutaḥ mandasānāḥ dhiyam
tvam indra svayaśāḥ ṛbhukṣāḥ vājaḥ na sādhuḥ astam eṣi
ti tiṣṭha savitar iti śrudhi asya hiraṇyapāṇe prabhṛtau
smat yuyavan amīvāḥ vājevāje avata vājinaḥ naḥ
raḥ divaḥ ā pṛthivyāḥ mitram vaha varuṇam indram agnim ā
ti na tasya rāyaḥ parietā asti ayam hi netā
taḥ bhaga satyarādhaḥ bhaga imām dhiyam ut ava dadat
peśaḥ sugaḥ te agne sanavittaḥ adhvā yukṣva sute haritaḥ
yanti vaninaḥ na śākhāḥ pra yajñaḥ etu hetvaḥ na saptiḥ ut
paprayantaḥ iḷām devīm barhiṣi sādayantaḥ aśvinā
smai anu dāt apasyām saḥ gha naḥ devaḥ savitā
vaḥ prathamam devayantaḥ indrapānam ūrmim akṛṇvata iḷaḥ tam
te cit hi pūrvīḥ abhi santi śāsā viśvān aryaḥ
ruṇā iha rakṣatam kulāyayat viśvayat mā naḥ ā gan
bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somam avase naḥ adya
ṛtasya ā naḥ dyāvāpṛthivī iti daivyena janena yātam
stenam rāya sārameya taskaram vā punaḥsara stotṝn indrasya
dhīraḥ niṇyā ciketa pṛśniḥ yat ūdhaḥ mahī jabhāra
vi vidyutaḥ na vṛṣṭibhiḥ rucānāḥ anu svadhām āyudhaiḥ
yanti ime sahaḥ sahasaḥ ā namanti ime śaṃsam vanuṣyataḥ
rema adha svam okaḥ abhi vaḥ syāma madhvaḥ vaḥ
marutaḥ vyantu viśvebhiḥ nāmabhiḥ naraḥ havīṃṣi dadāta naḥ
yaḥ deṣṇam tān ā rudrasya mīḷhuṣaḥ vivāse kuvit
kam mo iti su anyatra gantana ā ca naḥ barhiḥ sadata
oṃ yad adya maitrāvaruṇam

column2: īm vahanti sūryam ghṛtācīḥ dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ
ḷanam turāsaḥ ava vedim hotrābhiḥ yajeta ripaḥ kāḥ cit
na śaradaḥ pṛṇaithe iti pra uroḥ mitrāvaruṇā pṛthivyāḥ
stomebhiḥ etaśebhiḥ evaiḥ pra naḥ mitrāya varuṇāya vocaḥ
riāvivṛtsan yat etaśaḥ vahati dhūḥsu yuktaḥ
invatam jīradānū iti jīradānū devaḥ aryaḥ pra sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ
mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭim ghṛtaiḥ gavyūtim ukṣatam iḷābhiḥ prati vām
iṣam svar iti svaḥ ca dhīmahi bahavaḥ sūracakṣasaḥ
rathe tat cakṣuḥ devahitam śukram utcarat paśyema
vām nūnam aśvinā yuvākuḥ huve yat vām sute mādhvī iti
bhūtam ye rāyā maghadeyam junanti pra ye bandhum sūnṛtābhiḥ
rate aśvinā bhūt cyavānāya pratītyam haviḥde adhi yat
thaḥ vi vām rathaḥ vadhvā yādamānaḥ antān divaḥ bādhate vartanibhyām
thuḥ dhruvase na yonim sā vām sumatiḥ caniṣṭhā atāpi gharmaḥ
hmāṇi yuvayūni agman apa svasuḥ uṣasaḥ nak
rucandreṇa yātam abhi vām viśvāḥ niyutaḥ sacante
jate vandate ca aśnītam madhvaḥ aśvinau upāke ā
ti bibhrataḥ makṣuyubhiḥ narā hayebhiḥ aśvinā ā
syā yujānā parākāt pañca kṣitīḥ pari sadyaḥ jigāti
vānām ajaniṣṭa cakṣuḥ āviḥ akaḥ bhuvanam viśvam uṣāḥ
uṣaḥ sujāte prathamā jarasva eṣā netrī rādhasaḥ sūnṛtānām
divaḥ duhitaḥ vardhayanti uṣaḥ sujāte matibhiḥ vasiṣṭhāḥ sā asmāsu dhāḥ
kṣasā āvar iti āvaḥ vi añjate divaḥ anteṣu aktūn viśaḥ na yuktāḥ
oṃ praty u ṣaḍ prāgātham indrāvaruṇam daśaindrāvaruṇam

column2: tvā duhitaḥ divaḥ uṣaḥ jīrāḥ abhutsmahi yā vahasi puru spārham
khāni atṛntam ojasā ā sūryam airayatam divi prabhum indrāvaruṇā
uta vā yat āpyam mārḍīkam indrāvaruṇā ni yacchatam
havanaśrutā ā gatam indrāvaruṇā vadhanābhiḥ aprati bhedam vanvantā
ghnate vratāni anyaḥ abhi rakṣate sadā havāmahe vām vṛṣaṇā
ṣe vām arakṣasam manīṣām somam indrāya varuṇāya juhvat
kadā mṛḷīkam sumanāḥ abhi khyam pṛcche tat enaḥ varuṇa
upaśritaḥ cit astu śam naḥ kṣeme śam ūṃ iti yoge naḥ astu
tam divi praīṅkham hiraṇyayam śubhe kam ava sindhum varuṇaḥ
stotāram vipraḥ sudinatve ahnām yāt nu dyāvaḥ tatanan yāt
rma yuyopima mā naḥ tasmāt enasaḥ deva ririṣaḥ
cante īśānāsaḥ ye dadhate svaḥ naḥ gobhiḥ aśvebhiḥ vasubhiḥ
dravāyū iti sadatam barhiḥ ā idam niyuvānā niyutaḥ spārhavīrāḥ
ṇi sūribhiḥ syāma sasahvāṃsaḥ yudhā nṛbhiḥ amitrān
imām ūṃ iti su somasutim upa naḥ ā indrāgnī iti
bhiḥ vipanyavaḥ prayasvantaḥ havāmahe medhasātā saniṣyavaḥ indrāgnī iti
saḥ vavṛdhe naryaḥ yoṣaṇāsu vṛṣā śiśuḥ vṛṣabhaḥ yajñiyāsu
t bhadrā kṛṇavat sarasvatī akavaarī cetati vājinīvatī
tu preṣṭhaḥ bṛhaspatiḥ viśvavāraḥ yaḥ asti kāmaḥ rāyaḥ
ktiḥ brahma indrāya vajriṇe akāri bṛhaspate yuvam
kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra yadā it
abhitaḥ mayūkhaiḥ urum yajñāya cakrathuḥ ūṃ iti lokam janayantā
naḥ suvitasya bhūreḥ aśvavataḥ purucandrasya rāyaḥ triḥ devaḥ
oṃ tisraḥ ṣaṭ pārjanyaṃ tu parjanyāya tṛcaṃ gāyatram

column2: iti starīḥ ūṃ iti tvat bhavati sūte ūṃ iti tvat yathāvaśam
śayānāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ vratacāriṇaḥ vācam parjanyajinvitām pra maṇḍūkāḥ
rūpāḥ purutrā vācam pipiśuḥ vadantaḥ brāhmaṇāsaḥ atirātre na some
yayastu caruḥ agnivāniva brahmadviṣe kravyaade ghoracakṣase
dāsati druhā yaḥ mā pākena manasā carantam abhicaṣṭe anṛtebhiḥ
hanti asat vadantam ubhau indrasya prasitau śayāte iti yadi
van sam śiśādhi prāktāt apāktāt adharāt udaktāt abhi
radevāḥ ṛdantu mā te dṛśan sūryam utcarantam prati
dra asi me pituḥ uta bhrātuḥ abhuñjataḥ mātā ca me
mā bhūma niṣṭyāḥiva indra tvat araṇāḥiva vanāni na prajahitāni
yum mā tvā somasya galdayā sadā yācan aham girā bhūrṇim mṛgam na
daṃsanā mahān ugraḥ abhi vrataiḥ gamat saḥ śiprī na saḥ yoṣat
daśa mahyam ruśantaḥ naḷāḥiva sarasaḥ niḥ atiṣṭhan anu asya
trayaḥ kośāsaḥ ścotanti tisraḥ camvaḥ supūrṇāḥ samāne
iti stomam ciketa icchanti devāḥ sunvantam na svapnāya spṛhayanti yanti
davaḥ somāḥ ā yāhi śrītāḥ somāḥ ā yāhi
dhva enam priyamedhāḥ indram satrācā manasā yaḥ bhūt somaiḥ
iti puruvaso giraḥ vardhantu yāḥ mama pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ
na samudram asṛjaḥ mahīḥ apaḥ tat indra vṛṣṇi te śavaḥ
ryāḥiva viśvam it dhītam ānaśuḥ indram stomebhiḥ mahayantaḥ
pākasthāmā sudhuram kakṣyaprām adāt rāyaḥ vibodhanam yasmai
somam apibaḥ camū iti sutam jyeṣṭham tat dadhiṣe
avapānam ā gahi piba somam vaśān anu nimeghamānaḥ
yam vasu yam tvam hinoṣi martyam vemi tvā pūṣan ṛñjase
oṃ dūrād ekāna catvāriṃśad brahmātithir āśvinam

column2: vābhyām vājinīvasū iti vājinīvasū prati stomāḥ adṛkṣata vācam
ghavatbhyaḥ ca saprathaḥ chardiḥ yantam adābhyam ni su brahma janānām
vidhat samudre jahitaḥ narā yuvam kaṇvāya nāsatyā apiriptāya
rucandrā nāsatyā ā iha vām pruṣitapsavaḥ vayaḥ vahantu
jām ṛtasya piprataḥ pra yat bharanta vahnayaḥ viprāḥ ṛtasya vāhasā
dadhe ye tvām indra na tustuvuḥ ṛṣayaḥ ye ca tustuvuḥ mama it
dhuḥ tvām sutāsaḥ indavaḥ tava it indra pranītiṣu uta praśastiḥ
tim juṣasva pra su mām ava uta pra vardhaya matim uta
imām su pūrvyām dhiyam madhoḥ ghṛtasya pipyuṣīm kaṇvāḥ ukthena
vidharmaṇe mahe śuṣmāya yemire yuṣmān ūṃ iti naktam ūtaye
dhamanti anu vṛṣṭibhiḥ utsam duhantaḥ akṣitam ut ūṃ iti svanebhiḥ
randhram ayātana dyauḥ na cakradat bhiyā ā naḥ makhasya dāvane
bhiḥ ūtibhiḥ aśvinā gacchatam yuvam dasrā hiraṇyavartanī iti
vām ṛṣiḥ gīḥbhiḥ vatsaḥ avīvṛdhat ā vām vipraḥ iha
sumnāya tustavat vasuyāt dānunaḥ patī iti ā naḥ gantam riśādasā
vatsasya gantam avase pra asme yacchatam avṛkam pṛthu chardiḥ yuyutam
vām nāsatyā ukthaiḥ ācucyuvīmahi yat vā vāṇībhiḥ aśvinā
ya yacchatam abhutsi ūṃ iti pra devyā sākam vācā aham
n devān aham huve indrāviṣṇū iti aśvinau āśuheṣasā
anti cit santam aha yajñam martasya ripoḥ na upa veṣi
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ hariḥ oṃ yaḥ indra trayastriṃśat parvata

column2: kṣitha imam juṣasva girvaṇaḥ samudraḥiva pinvate indra
indrāya jījanat purupraśastam ūtaye ṛtasya yat abhi
viviktaḥ rodasī iti na antarikṣāṇi vajriṇam amāt it asya
saḥ mahān hi saḥ saḥ prathame viomani devānām sadane vṛdhaḥ
rā dāśuṣaḥ gṛham namasvinaḥ tūtujānaḥ mahemate aśvebhiḥ
ukthāni ṛtuthā dadhe śuciḥ pāvakaḥ ucyate saḥ adbhutaḥ tat it
ra abhi svarantu ye tava rudrāsaḥ sakṣata śriyam uto iti
mim vi avartayat cakrāṇaḥ opaśam divi vāvṛdhānasya te vayam viśvā dhanāni
indra saṃsadam viṣūcīm vi anāśayaḥ somapāḥ uttaraḥ bhavan
kṣayaḥ mitraḥ gṛṇāti varuṇaḥ tvām śardhaḥ madati anu
jayanti tam it cyautnaiḥ āryanti tam kṛtebhiḥ carṣaṇayaḥ eṣaḥ
naḥ sutavantaḥ havāmahe ā naḥ yāhi sutavataḥ asmākam
napāt pranapād iti pranapāt kuṇḍapāyyaḥ ni asmin dadhre
aṃhasaḥ sadāvṛdhā uta syā naḥ divā matiḥ aditiḥ
upa dvayuḥ pākatrā sthana devāḥ hṛtsu jānītha martyam upa dvayum
saḥ devam aratim dadhanvire devatrā havyam ā ūhire
dyaḥ tve iti kṣemāsaḥ api santi sādhavaḥ tvam rājā rayīṇām
ra yat sasahat sadane kam cit atriṇam manyum janasya
ryam agniḥ ghṛtebhiḥ āhutaḥ yadi ghṛtebhiḥ āhutaḥ vāśīm
tave pra saḥ agne tava ūtibhiḥ suvīrābhiḥ tirate vājabharmabhiḥ
satpatiḥ uta me prayiyoḥ vayiyoḥ suvāstvāḥ adhi
